data.description: Any creature within 30 feet of a jack-o'-lantern must succeed at a DC %1 Will save or be shaken for 2d6 minutes. If the Will save is successful, the creature is immune to that jack-o'-lantern's fear aura for 24 hours. This is a vision-based mind-affecting fear effect.
data.name: Fear Aura
